WrappedToolbar.note: The provider has no markup of its own, so it is photographed around a real icon toolbar with one member defaultOpen. Caption and bubble are clear of each other.

DelayDuration.note: The provider's one meaningful prop shown on both settings: delayDuration 0 with the bubble already open, and 600 with the triggers at rest.
